action_items.item_text: The Bidders shall not have a conflict of interest that affects the Bidding Process
action_items.evidence_quote: The Bidders shall not have a conflict of interest that affects the Bidding Process. Any Bidder found to have conflict of interest shall be disqualified.

action_items.item_text: Bidder must be registered on DMRC's e-tendering portal to participate
action_items.evidence_quote: For participation in e-tendering process, the prospective bidder(s) has to be registered on DMRC's e-tendering portal https://eprocure.gov.in/eprocure/app.

action_items.item_text: Tender Document can only be downloaded or uploaded using Class-II or Class-III digital signature
action_items.evidence_quote: The Tender Document can only be downloaded or uploaded using Class-II or Class-III digital signature of the authorized signatory.

action_items.item_text: Cost of Tender Document Rs. 29,500/- non-refundable acceptable online only
action_items.evidence_quote: Rs. 29,500/- (Rs.25,000 /- + 18% GST). Cost of Tender Document shall be acceptable through online mode only i.e. RTGS/NEFT/IMPS/Customer payment portal.

action_items.item_text: Bid Security/EMD Rs. 16,94,000/- acceptable online only
action_items.evidence_quote: Rs.16,94,000/- (Rs. Sixteen Lakhs Ninty Four Thousand Only). Bid Security amount shall be acceptable through online mode only i.e. RTGS /NEFT /IMPS /Customer payment portal.

action_items.item_text: Period of Sale of Tender Document online from 30.08.2024 to 30.09.2024 (upto 1500hrs)
action_items.evidence_quote: From 30.08.2024 to 30.09.2024 (upto 1500hrs) e-tendering website https://eprocure.gov.in/eprocure/app

action_items.item_text: Pre-Bid queries must be sent latest by 1700 hrs on 05.09.2024
action_items.evidence_quote: Further, bidders are requested to send Pre-bid queries on the registered official email of DMRC i.e. pbttenders@dmrc.org latest by 1700 hrs on 05.09.2024. Queries received after 1700 hrs on shall not be entertained.

action_items.item_text: Validity of Bid up to 180 days from the last date of submission of Bid
action_items.evidence_quote: Up to 180 days from the last date of submission of Bid.
action_items.date_text: Up to 180 days from the last date of submission of Bid
action_items.anchor_event: last date of submission of Bid

action_items.item_text: Bid summarily rejected if not accompanied with Tender Cost and/or EMD
action_items.evidence_quote: The offer/bid of a bidder shall be declared as ineligible and the bid/Application shall be summarily rejected if it is not accompanied with the above Tender Cost &/or EMD.

action_items.item_text: Duplicate transaction reference number for more than one bid leads to summary rejection
action_items.evidence_quote: If the same transaction reference number has been submitted for more than one bid, then all such bids shall be considered ineligible and summarily rejected.

action_items.item_text: Tender security must be made from the account of bidder only (or constituent member in JV)
action_items.evidence_quote: Bidders to note that the payment of tender security shall be made from the account of bidder only, however, in case of JV / Consortium, the tender security can either be paid from JV/Consortium account or one of the constituent members of JV / Consortium.

action_items.item_text: Late bids after due date & time shall not be accepted under any circumstances
action_items.evidence_quote: (f) Bids received after due Date & Time of Submission (e-tender) of Bids shall not be accepted under any circumstances.

action_items.item_text: Lead Member of JV/Consortium must maintain minimum 51% aggregate shareholding during full tenure
action_items.evidence_quote: II. The Lead Member of the JV/Consortium shall maintain a minimum percentage share of 51% of the aggregate shareholding of the JV/Consortium during full tenure of License Agreement.

action_items.item_text: Change in JV stake without DMRC approval entitles DMRC to encash security deposit or terminate with 30 days notice
action_items.evidence_quote: III. Any change in percentage stake of JV/Consortium members without prior written approval of DMRC shall be treated as Material Breach of Contract and Licensee's Event of Default entitling DMRC to encash Security Deposit/Performance Security and/or to terminate the License Agreement after 30 days' notice.

action_items.item_text: Minimum percentage stake of any member in JV/Consortium shall not be less than 15%
action_items.evidence_quote: IV. Minimum percentage stake of any member in JV/Consortium during license period (including lock-in period) shall not be less than 15%.

action_items.item_text: Partners having less than 26% participation considered non-substantial and not considered for eligibility
action_items.evidence_quote: V. Partners having less than 26% participation shall be considered as non-substantial partner and shall not be considered for evaluation which means that their eligibility shall not be considered for evaluation of JV/Consortium.

action_items.item_text: All members of JV/Consortium jointly and severally liable for due performance
action_items.evidence_quote: VI. All members of such entity shall be jointly and severely liable for the due performance of License agreement.
